author: Diego
title: Trip planning is moving to AI assistants and creators
detail: The pack's value chain lists 'search and AI assistants' at the inspire-and-plan step.
whoAffected: Destination marketers, OTAs, small operators who aren't visible there
implication: Operators missing from AI answers may lose discovery.
notes: Source to find: a survey with the share of U.S. travelers using AI to plan trips. The AI answer gave a percentage but no source we could open, so we left it out.
